page_title: BOC 2-2 HOL | Bochum v Holstein Kiel 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Mats Pannewig (Bochum) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
90+4' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+2' The attendance is 26000.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

89' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Steven Skrzybski. The score is now 2:2.
87' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) is caught offside!
86' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Decent spell from Holstein Kiel here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The linesman points to the corner flag, Holstein Kiel are going to take it.
85' The substitution is prepared. Mats Pannewig (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Philipp Hofmann.
83' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
81' That's the end of the game for Armin Gigovic, who is replaced by Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel).
79' Marcel Rapp prepares a substitution. Max Geschwill is replaced by Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel).
78' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Felix Passlack (Bochum) gets booked.
77' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
75' Holstein Kiel are ruled offside.

74' Close! Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.

73' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Patrick Drewes. This effort really didn't trouble him.
71' The foul by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) was seen by Martin Petersen who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Holstein Kiel.
69' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.

69' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Timon Weiner leaps like a salmon to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.

68' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) received the ball far out and fired a projectile which went yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
65' Dani de Wit (Bochum) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
64' Lewis Holtby will be replaced by Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel).
64' Marcel Rapp decides to make a substitution. Andu Yobel Kelati will be replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
63' Peter Zeidler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) replacing Lukas Daschner.
63' Substitution. Myron Boadu makes way for Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
61' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
61' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is behind the touchline and Bochum will take a throw-in.
58' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
57' Martin Petersen interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel). A free kick has been awarded to Bochum.

55' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.

51' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Holstein Kiel, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Dani de Wit (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
46' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Bochum have a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Marcel Rapp decided to make a change. Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) is replaced by Lasse Rosenboom.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+2' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
45+1' Holstein Kiel fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Bochum hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
40' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
39' Matus Bero (Bochum) is booked for saying more than Martin Petersen was willing to tolerate.
38' Holstein Kiel keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
35' 2 - 1 Lukas Daschner (Bochum) receives a precise pass inside the box from Philipp Hofmann and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 2:1.
34' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
32' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
29' The ball is out of play and Bochum manage to earn a corner.
28' A spell of possession for Bochum in an attempt to control the game.
25' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) launches a cross from the corner, but Patrick Drewes is alert to thwart the effort.

23' 1 - 1 Goal! Myron Boadu displays great vision and sends a pass to Matus Bero (Bochum), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
21' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Some patient build-up play from Bochum as they look to unlock the defence.
16' Substitution. Anthony Losilla (Bochum) replaces Erhan Masovic.
15' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
14' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
12' A player from Bochum brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Holstein Kiel will take a free kick.
11' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.

9' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a cross from the free kick. His effort is a bit too strong and the ball flies behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
8' Martin Petersen blows his whistle after Erhan Masovic (Bochum) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Holstein Kiel in a dangerous position.
2' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
2' Holstein Kiel are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will supervise the game today.
